parsed.notes:
WHAT YOU NEED defaults to required; NICE-TO-HAVES makes its items optional. Read 'preferably' as an inline preference applying only to the parenthesized tools, not SQL or BI tools.
Snowflake and Looker occur in both preference lists; their optional mentions collapse.
Full stack development and experimental design appear only in responsibilities and are excluded. The Data Scientist role title and experience requirement are not treated as a separately requested Data Science technique.
Reporting and dashboards are retained as unmapped rather than assuming the distinct skill of data visualization. Modern data stack and analytics engineering are not expanded into unnamed parent skills.
The testing criterion quotes the optional development-cycle mention, not the responsibilities mention.
Seniority uses the four-year requirement. 'Help lead the future of analytics' is treated as aspirational rather than an explicit team-lead duty; flagged because a literal leadership reading could instead support senior.
No German-language requirement or degree is mentioned.
